visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler girl with dark hair tied in pigtails, wearing a beige vest over a brown long-sleeved shirt and green plaid trousers, stands in a brightly lit indoor home setting. She holds a large grey plush shark hat, looking at it with focused eyes. A yellow children's book lies on the light-colored wood floor next to her bare feet. The lighting is bright and natural. (2) The scene changes as the child now wears a yellow long-sleeved shirt with a bear graphic. An adult's hands enter the frame to place an oversized plush giraffe hat on the girl's head. The hat has a very long neck that sways significantly as the child moves her head. The background includes a child-sized play kitchen and storage shelves. (3) The child walks around the room wearing the cumbersome giraffe hat. The hat is heavy and frequently slips down, partially covering her eyes. She uses her hands to adjust the long plush neck. The camera follows her movement using handheld tracking. (4) The girl is seen again wearing the plush shark hat. The shark's head is large, with its mouth open around her face. She looks directly at the camera with a calm expression, then smiles slightly. The room is clean and modern. (5) A pink graphic end screen appears featuring a cartoon illustration of the little girl and brand text. The lighting is flat and the scene is static.
